segments.en: In the beautiful city of Verona, there were two rich and powerful families, the Montague's and the Capulets.
They had an old and angry feud.
Even their servants and friends fought in the streets and the Prince of the city was very angry about it.
One day, the Capulet family planned a grand masked ball.
Romeo, who was a Montague, was feeling very sad.
His friends convinced him to go to the party secretly.
He wore a mask to hide his face from the enemies.
At the party, Romeo saw Juliet.
She was the most beautiful girl he had ever seen.
They talked and fell in love at first sight before they knew their families were enemies.
When they found out the truth, they were shocked, but their love was too strong.
Later that night, Romeo secretly went to Juliet's garden.
He stood under her balcony.
They talked under the moonlight and promised to love each other forever.
The next day, they went to a kind monk named Friar Lawrence.
He married them secretly, hoping this marriage would bring peace to the two families.
But happiness didn't last long.
Juliet's angry cousins started a street fight with Romeo's best friend.
In the chaos, a terrible accident happened and Romeo was blamed.
The Prince of Verona exiled Romeo from the city forever.
Juliet was heartbroken.
To make things worse, her father told her she must marry a rich man named Paris.
Juliet ran to Friar Lawrence for help.
He gave her a special sleeping potion.
He told her...
Drink this.
You'll fall into a deep sleep and appear to be dead.
I'll send a letter to Romeo, explaining our plan.
Juliet drank the potion and her sad family put her in the family tomb.
Unfortunately, the letter never reached Romeo.
Instead, a friend told him that Juliet was gone forever.
Romeo could not live without her, so he bought a fast horse and went back to Verona.
Romeo arrived at the tomb and saw Juliet.
He thought she was really gone.
His heart could not take the pain and he passed away from deep sadness right next to her.
Moments later, Juliet woke up from her deep sleep.
When she saw Romeo's lifeless body, her heart broke too and she joined him in eternal sleep.
When the Montagues and Capulets saw this tragedy, they cried bitterly.
They finally understood that their foolish hate had a very high price.
Ashamed, they stopped fighting, built golden statues of Romeo and Juliet and made peace forever.
